items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: That's Johnny Pope, myself, and a fellow named Denny Trainor. ... I stayed in it until I just got tired and went down... There's only three of us that played in the late year

ctx.x: Yes, over there, they talk about them, yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

And, uh, when I joined it, uh, they, they kind of appointed me as secretary, and I kept a record of the, of the jobs we'd play, and what we got out the job, and what each man received, and so on. And, uh, I was, I was the only one, however, with the secretary that locked things down, you see, the fellas, they were kind of be a, a paymaster, received them on in, to pay off, or something like that, but they never would keep a record of what the band was doing, you see. Yes, that's very interesting. But when I, when…
You have some of the music there, too.
